k-confidential.title: Confidential Cat $cCAT coins
k-confidential.sourceSays: Posts say traders are running a 'Confidential Cat' meme on Solana's confidential-transactions theme; others debate the ticker (cCAT, hCAT) and some say it is a vamp of an earlier cat meme.
k-confidential.reason: Posts of Nov 22-23 discuss the meme itself, its ticker naming after zCAT/hSOL and a rival cat idea; all pools opened within hours. Origin is unverified; many other posts are call-group shills.

k-sym-SI.reason: The Super Intelligence story is from Oct and Super Inu is 1500h old; the new $SI pools are two 'Solana Inu' copycat tickers 0.3h old with no description or story of their own.
